name: guardian naga
desc: Guardian Naga is a CR 10 monstrosity.

actions.name: rejuvenation
actions.desc: If it dies, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its hit points. Only a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.3okM6Gn63zzEULkz]{Wish} spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The naga is an 11th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks), and it needs only verbal components to cast its spells. It has the following cleric spells prepared: Cantrips (at will): [[/item .kjmjY0zlE6IEiQVL]]{mending}, [[/item .n9pJzTDsAwQxJVRl]]{sacred flame}, [[/item .MUO1uYN7JR1hm4dR]]{thaumaturgy} 1st level (4 slots): [[/item .arzCrMRgcNiQuh43]]{command}, [[/item .uUWb1wZgtMou0TVP]]{cure wounds}, [[/item .jZ6JNykRtdQ90MOo]]{shield of faith} 2nd level (3 slots): [[/item .3MYDjS6k9IYL0aTj]]{calm emotions}, [[/item .3Lo9boi7P2ro6QV4]]{hold person} 3rd level (3 slots): [[/item .pO4zGe5LmFIYqJiL]]{bestow curse}, [[/item .cg50KpBkBdPK6vPL]]{clairvoyance} 4th level (3 slots): [[/item .pxpb2eOB6bv4phAf]]{banishment}, [[/item .da0a1t2FqaTjRZGT]]{freedom of movement} 5th level (2 slots): [[/item .5e1xTohkzqFqbYH4]]{flame strike}, [[/item .JQyigMNPiDnGI18b]]{geas} 6th level (1 slot): [[/item .XzkJpE6XpZfKjODD]]{true seeing}

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. The target must make a [[/save]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=Z2wqSwuJDKaRy2TA]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
